descriptionChirho: Gentilic noun (masculine) designating a person or people from the Phoenician city of Sidon, used in both singular and plural with various prepositional and conjunctive prefixes.
Feminine gentilic noun designating women from Sidon, distinguished in Hebrew by the feminine plural suffix -ot (צִידֹנִיּוֹת), as in the context of foreign wives (cf. 1 Kings 11:1).
